name: ARK_DOOR
canonical: a close view of the ONE single great square door of Noah's ark — the lone high doorway set in the long flat side of a colossal rectangular chest-like wooden ark built of pitch-blackened gopher-wood planks, shaped like an enormous flat-sided floating BOX with a long low pitched gable roof running its whole length and a SINGLE large square doorway set high in one long flat side — NOT a sailing ship, NOT a boat with a curved or pointed hull, NOT a shed, cabin or house, the single entrance shown standing open; no other door anywhere; NOT a covenant chest, NOT an ordinary house door
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
